notes.title: Dead by Backrooms Anomaly – Full Release is Here!
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="WgQmZnA4hlg;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Step into a haunting journey where shadows whisper and reality bends. In Searching for Love in Dreams, you’ll question whether you’re chasing the truth… or simply the echoes of your own mind.

Navigate eerie, haunted corridors, unravel cryptic puzzles, and witness surreal, psychedelic visions that peel back the secrets of the past.

Experienced from a first-person perspective, this exploration-driven, narrative-focused psychological horror adventure places you in the shoes of a strong female protagonist, caught in a tangled web where reality and fantasy blur beyond recognition.

Are you ready to face what lies within… and beyond?

Contact: [url="https://darkrookinteractive@gmail.com"]darkrookinteractive@gmail.com[/url][/p]

notes.title: Dead by Backrooms Anomaly is Now Available!
notes.content:
[p][b]Dead by Backrooms Anomaly is Now Available! [/b] 

[i]Dead by Backrooms Anomaly[/i], the unique blend of psychological horror and absurd comedy, has officially launched on Steam! Dive into a mysterious love story wrapped in darkness, where you'll be scared, intrigued, and even laugh along the way. With its surreal atmosphere, unexpected plot twists, and clever puzzles, this indie title promises a one-of-a-kind experience. Developed entirely by a solo creator, your support means everything. Step into the shadows — it's time to face the anomaly! [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ATLAEpr6XGk;full"][/previewyoutube]
